atomic_facts.fact: Builder.ai was founded by Sachin Dev Duggal.
The full legal name of Builder.ai is Engineer.ai Cloud Services India Private Limited.
The bankruptcy case is in a Delaware bankruptcy court.
The bankruptcy filing was dated June 2, 2025.
Builder.ai had a partnership with Microsoft.
The New York Times reported on Builder.ai and its Microsoft partnership on August 31, 2025.
Builder.ai's relationship with Microsoft was a partnership rather than an acquisition.
No official Microsoft press release or SEC filing indicates an acquisition of Builder.ai in 2025.
The New York Times coverage of Builder.ai's collapse states that no Microsoft press release or SEC filing indicates an acquisition.
